decision_rationale: Indicates when a deployment lacks a restart policy set to Always or OnFailure, reducing fault tolerance (kube-linter v0.8.3).
Flags resources that fail validation against the Kubernetes API schema using kubeconform, a manifest correctness issue (kube-linter v0.8.3).
Indicates when NetworkPolicies have no associated deployments, a stale cross-object reference (kube-linter v0.8.3).
Indicates when NetworkPolicy ingress/egress rules do not match any deployments, broken references within the policy (kube-linter v0.8.3).
Indicates when Services do not have any associated deployments, a dangling reference between objects (kube-linter v0.8.3).
Indicates when a ServiceMonitor's selectors do not match any services, a stale monitoring configuration (kube-linter v0.8.3).
Alerts on services of forbidden types such as NodePort and LoadBalancer that expose workloads outside the cluster boundary (kube-linter v0.8.3).
Indicates when a liveness probe references an unexposed port so the probe fails at runtime, harming availability (kube-linter v0.8.3).
Alerts on deployments with no node affinity defined, an opinionated scheduling-placement policy outside the four smell categories (kube-linter v0.8.3).
